title: Open a catalogue product in a new tab using native browser gestures
steps: Move the pointer over the Aurora Desk Lamp product name in the loaded catalogue.
Right-click the Aurora Desk Lamp product name, pause, and dismiss the browser context menu.
Middle-click the same Aurora Desk Lamp product name and inspect the page that opens.
If a separate tab opened, return to the original catalogue tab and inspect its state.

video_guide.summary: The product row exposes native link actions. Aurora Desk Lamp opens in a separate tab while the original product list remains available.

chapters.note: All products is open with Aurora Desk Lamp in the first row.
The product row's context menu offers Open link in new tab and Copy link address.
After middle-clicking, a new tab is present while the original tab still displays All products.
The new tab displays Aurora Desk Lamp's product detail page.
Returning to the original tab shows the unchanged product list.
